items.content_html:
NOT FINISHED YET.

This will impact EVERYONE.

 

The EHRC, Equality and Human Rights Commission recently published a new guidence on single-sex spaces, and the terms for each sex. The EHRC responded to the supreme court ruling that 'Women', 'Men' and 'Sex' is refered to biological sex at birth.

 

Firstly, in my opinion i think this will impact everyone. My reasoning behind this is that; not everyone looks the same. There are some woman that are a bit tall, may present more masculine or have short hair. And that is perfectly fine, however because those woman may not look like 'Society's beauty standards', which consists of; slim bodies, grooming, makeup and many more. So of course some transphobic people may think they are not the gender there were assigned at birth, and this can and will cause verbal abuse and possibly physical abuse.

 

Secondly, since they want trans women in men's bathrooms and trans men and woman's spaces, they will get abused aswell by transphobic people.

Also for passing trans women and trans men, they may get looks and even get told to leave the space they are forced to go in as that they may not think that they are transgender. Especially since transphobic people that want trans men in woman's toilets some women may even feel uncombable with trans men as that some trans men that have medicaly transitioned have full one beards and look more manly than a cis man.

 

Personaly since i do not pass that much, i use the accessible toilets so i don't have a problem with this new guidence with myself. However this angers me
